title: CoCCoA: Complex Chemistry in hot Cores with ALMA. Selected oxygen-bearing species
question: What are the column density ratios of six oxygen-bearing complex organic molecules (O-COMs) with respect to methanol in 14 high-mass protostellar sources, and how do they constrain COM formation through ice and/or gas-phase chemistry?

what.value: O-COM column density ratios in five low-mass protostars observed with ALMA

evidence.quote: We compare our observational results of high-mass protostellar sources with the results of low-mass sources in literature (cite: Jorgensen2018; Manigand2020; MvG2020) and the simulation results of COM chemistry in (cite: Garrod2022).

what.value: Source luminosities and distances for the 14 high-mass targets

evidence.quote: **References –** \[1\] (cite: Cyganowski2011), \[2\] (cite: Williams2022), \[3\] (cite: Issac2020), \[4\] (cite: Ge2014), \[5\] (cite: Towner2021), \[6\] (cite: Tang2018), \[7\] (cite: Csengeri2022), \[8\] (cite: Konig2017)

external_data.citation: (cite: Cyganowski2011; Williams2022; Issac2020; Ge2014; Towner2021; Tang2018; Csengeri2022; Konig2017; Beltran2014; Wu2014; Sanchez-Monge2013; Zhang2009; Faundez2004; Maud2015; WidicusWeaver2017; Sandell2000; Chibueze2014)

what.value: O-COM ratios in outbursting protostar V883 Ori, disk Oph IRS 48, and comets 67P/C-G and 46P/Wirtanen

evidence.quote: We compare them with the literature data of the outbursting protostar V883(FU) Ori (cite: Lee2019NatAs) and the protoplanetary disk around Oph IRS 48 (cite: Brunken2022).

Two comets, 67P/Churyumov–Gerasimenko (67P/C–G) (cite: Robin2019; Drozdovskaya2019) and 46P/Wirtanen (cite: Biver2021), are also taken into account, which reflect the pristine chemical composition in our solar system.

recipe.goal: Generate moment 0 maps and extract single-pixel spectra
recipe.method: Make integrated intensity (moment 0) maps of the unblended CH3OH 19_{3,17}-19_{2,18} line and extract spectra from the peak methanol pixel (or brightest pixel on the ring for G34.30+0.20, or offset by ~9 pixels for G34.41+0.24 and ~3 pixels for G23.21-0.37 to reduce line blending)
key_parameters: CH3OH 19_{3,17}-19_{2,18} transition (E_up = 490 K, A_ij = 9.27e-5 s^-1); extraction coordinates in Table 1
assumptions: Other O-COMs peak at similar locations to methanol emission

recipe.goal: Identify lines and fit LTE synthetic spectra for O-COMs and methanol isotopologues
recipe.method: Identify transitions using JPL and CDMS catalogs in CASSIS and fit LTE models (N, T_ex, FWHM, v_lsr) per species using chi^2 grid-fitting on unblended lines for narrow/weak sources or interactive visual inspection for blended/bright sources; use 2-component fits where lines are double-peaked and restrict MF fits to A_ij < 10^-4 s^-1 where optically thick
key_parameters: 3-sigma detection threshold for unblended lines; T_ex fixed to MF when unconstrained; T_ex of g-EG fixed to a-EG
assumptions: Single excitation temperature (LTE) per species; vibrational corrections applied to GA and EG

recipe.goal: Infer main methanol column density and compute O-COM column density ratios
recipe.method: Calculate 16O/18O ratio from Galactocentric distance D_GC for each source, multiply N(CH3^18OH) by 16O/18O to get N(CH3OH), sum a-EG and g-EG, and compute ratios N(O-COM)/N(CH3OH) and pairwise O-COM ratios to compare with low-mass protostars, comets, and Garrod et al. (2022) models
key_parameters: (16O/18O) = (58.8 +/- 11.8) D_GC + (37.1 +/- 82.6); intercept error excluded from main error propagation
assumptions: CH3^18OH lines are optically thin while 13CH3OH lines are marginally optically thick

answer_key.quantity: Typical methanol (CH3OH) column density across sample

evidence.quote: With the uniform beam size of 0.33$''$, most sources have a methanol column density of 10$^{18}$–10$^{19}$ cm$^{-2}$, except the weakest source IRAS 1851-1208, which has $N=7\times10^{17}$cm$^{-2}$.

answer_key.quantity: DME and MF column density ratios with respect to methanol

evidence.quote: Among the six species, DME and MF have the highest and similar ratios with respect to methanol (2–3%).

answer_key.quantity: CH3CHO and GA column density ratios with respect to methanol

evidence.quote: and GA have the lowest ratios at around 0.1%.

answer_key.quantity: Excitation temperature of C2H5OH, MF, and a-EG

score_reason: Extraction coordinates, spectroscopic transition lists, isotope calibration equations, and per-source best-fit parameters (N, T_ex, FWHM, v_lsr) are thoroughly tabulated, and CASA/tclean settings are mostly described. However, self-calibrated cubes are not yet released, manual continuum window parameters and self-calibration details are omitted, and visual-inspection spectral fits for blended sources cannot be identically automated.
rediscovery_reason: Raw ALMA data (2019.1.00246.S) are public in the ALMA archive, exact extraction coordinates and transition lists are provided in Tables 1 and A.1, and all derived column densities and excitation temperatures are tabulated for direct quantitative comparison.
